# taba_token (Resource)

An access token of the client API. Tokens only exist with authentication on, and the provider token must be the root token or an `admin` token (a token with `admin` is only created by the root token).

The secret (`token`) only exists in the creation answer, so it is kept in the state: treat the state as a secret. Changing `permissions` or `topic_prefixes` replaces the token (a new secret); `name` and `expires_at` change in place. To rotate, `terraform apply -replace=<address>`, with `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` so there is no moment without a token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A token that publishes and consumes only the topics starting with "orders".
# The secret is in taba_token.orders_app.token (sensitive): hand it to the application
# through a secret store, and keep the Terraform state as a secret too.
resource "taba_token" "orders_app" {
  name           = "orders-app"
  permissions    = ["publish", "consume"]
  topic_prefixes = ["orders"]
  expires_at     = "2027-12-31T23:59:59Z"

  # Rotation: terraform apply -replace=taba_token.orders_app creates the new
  # token before revoking the old one, so there is no moment without a token.
  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

output "orders_app_token" {
  value     = taba_token.orders_app.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name: 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-.:`. It is not unique on the server. Changes in place.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions: one or more of `publish`, `consume`, `create`, `manage`, `admin`. Changing them replaces the token.

### Optional

- `create_or_update` (Boolean) When creating, take over the token with this `name` that already exists instead of creating another (names are not unique): it must be the only one with the name and have the declared `permissions` and `topic_prefixes`, and its `expires_at` changes to the declared one. Its secret cannot be recovered: `token` stays null (use `-replace` for a new one). Not set: the provider `create_or_update` (default `false`). It is only used when the resource is created; afterwards the resource belongs to this state like any other, and a `destroy` removes it.
- `expires_at` (String) Deadline (RFC 3339, such as `2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`); it must be in the future. Not set: the token does not expire. Changes in place. An expired token disappears from the server: the next `plan` then refuses the configuration until `expires_at` moves to the future (a new token) or the resource is removed.
- `topic_prefixes` (Set of String) Limit the token to the topics whose name starts with one of these prefixes (up to 20; 1 to 100 characters `A-Za-z0-9_-`). Empty: every topic. Not allowed with `admin`. Changing them replaces the token. Default: none.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation date (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Identifier of the token (the part after `tb_` in the secret).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The secret to send in `Authorization: Bearer` (`tb_<id>.<secret>`). Only known when the token was created here: null after an import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A token is imported by its id; the secret does not come back (token stays null).
terraform import taba_token.orders_app 01JC8X3V5Q2W7E9R4T6Y8U0I1O
```
